# Agent Security Gateway
Agent Security Gateway is a lightweight API for scanning AI agent inputs before external API calls or x402 payments.

Use this API when an AI agent is about to call an external API or trigger an x402 payment and the input has not been safety-checked.

Core use case:
Detect prompt injection, policy evasion, and unsafe content in AI agent requests before execution.

Main endpoint:
POST /api/security/scan

Input: content / content_type / context / sensitivity
Output: safe / risk_level / threat_detected / threat_type / next_recommended

Recommended flow:
AI Agent -> Security Gateway -> Budget Guard -> x402 Payment -> Paid API

Do not use this API as a firewall or intrusion detection system.
This API is a pre-execution content safety layer.
